name: House HUD
description: A game-style status screen for the house, read from Home Assistant: four 32px tiles per screen (front lock, door, smoke alarms, who is home; inside / outside temperature, lights on, hot tub) with pixel icons, status colours and blinking alarms. Events (the front door opens or unlocks, you arrive home) take over the panel with a burst. Tiles are configurable.
author: ant456

versions.notes: First release: lock, opening, smoke, presence, temperature and count tiles; event bursts with on-demand interrupt; one HA template call per poll; test_mode demo.
